versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Start on APIDot" section to guide users directly from ClawHub to key APIDot entry points.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or integration behavior; guidance and routing remain documentation-only.
- Clarified navigation flow for model documentation, account setup, and code examples.

- Added references/api.md for local non-executable API notes and routing guidance.
- Updated SKILL.md to reference the new api.md file and clarify the scope.
- Removed skill-card.md from the distribution.
- No executable code or API calls added; remains documentation- and reference-only.

- Initial release featuring documentation-only guidance for using APIDot Tripo H3.1 3D APIs.
- Explains 3D asset generation modes: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, and multiview-to-3D via APIDot.
- Covers async workflows, including task submission, polling, task ID handling, and webhooks.
- Lists security best practices for handling the APIDot API key.
- Includes official links to APIDot docs, model pages, and examples.
- No executable files, scripts, or bundled API clients are included—documentation only.
